name: NASA: Pioneer 10 inbound to Jupiter
description: 3 December 1973, a few hours before Pioneer 10's closest approach to Jupiter (about 130,000 km above the cloud tops) on the first outer-planet encounter. The probe is 1.7 years into its mission, so its four RTGs have already faded a little; use the Ship systems window (F1) to switch instruments off as the power budget requires.
